mechanics.title: Book editor
mechanics.description: Copy/paste/clear single pages or whole books, add or remove pages, import and export books to disk, a per-page character counter (vanilla 256-character limit), color and formatting buttons, and reset-style buttons. Signed books get page navigation and search.

mechanics.title: Sign editor
mechanics.description: Clear, copy, paste, save to disk and load from disk for signs.

mechanics.title: Unicode and colors
mechanics.description: A picker with 70+ unicode characters usable in books, signs, chat and anvil names.

qol: Because it only uses vanilla features, players without the mod still see the results.
getting_started: Open a Book and Quill or a sign to see the new toolbar buttons.
editor_notes: May overlap with Improved Sign Editing on the sign screen.
name: Stendhal
summary: Client-side editor improvements for books, signs, the anvil rename box and chat. Adds buttons for copying, pasting, clearing, importing and exporting book pages and signs, plus a formatting and color picker and a unicode character list.
